verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so HR-synced onboarding and offboarding checklists are a fair axis, but the pack documents no HR integration, no onboarding or offboarding checklists, and no tracking of security-training completion. The MDM remote action for offboarded devices and the monitoring of Google Workspace and GitHub user accounts are adjacent features. They do not show that every leaver lost access or that every hire completed training.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
